items.title: Ipswich Town v Liverpool: Premier League – live
items.summary: Premier League updates from the 8pm BST kick-off Live scoreboard | Read Football Daily | Email Scott The teams are out! Ipswich in blue, Liverpool in red. A wonderful start-of-the-weekend, possibly-a-few-pints-to-the-good atmosphere under the lights at Portman Road! Not long now. In the meantime, here’s Dave Estherby with some pre-match words of encouragement for Liverpool: “Not really sure what’s going on upstairs at Anfield. Another summer where they’ve spaffed money up the wall for unproven PL players without realising they need a goalkeeper, two full backs, a centre half, two forwards, a winger and a replacement for whatever Mac Allister is supposed to do. AND back up for Ekitike who probably won’t play until the new year at least. Shambles. I feel sorry for Iraola, he couldn’t really turn them down but it might end up a backwards step.” Pre-match postbag. “Leaving aside Liverpool’s less than imperial start to the season, you have to admit that’s a very tasty teamsheet on offer tonight - the right blend of youth, experience, Hungary’s answer to Bryan Robson and a World Cup winner in the middle of the park, a striker coveted by Man City, a Champions League winner on the bench and in Wirtz our very own Juan Sebastian Veron!” – Peadar de Burca Continue reading...

items.title: Heracles dendert door, NAC lijdt schipbreuk in Waalwijk
items.summary: Heracles Almelo heeft ook zijn vijfde wedstrijd in de Keuken Kampioen Divisie gewonnen. De mannen van Vincent Heilmann hadden vrijdagavond geen mededogen met het zieltogende De Graafschap: 5-0. In Waalwijk zagen de supporters van NAC hoe hun boottocht op de 'Titanac' eindigde in schipbreuk: RKC versloeg de provinciegenoot.

items.title: Kostons verstiert droomdebuut Babadi bij Sparta en bezorgt PEC een punt
items.summary: Sparta Rotterdam en PEC Zwolle hielden elkaar vrijdagavond in evenwicht. De Rotterdammers leken via uitblinker Milan Zonneveld en debutant Isaac Babadi op weg naar een zege, maar tien minuten voor het einde maakte PEC gelijk. Zo blijven beide ploegen in het rechterrijtje van de Eredivisie staan.

items.title: Chelsea hit bullseye with Morgan Rogers as Arsenal rue what might have been
items.summary: The Gunners will have a look at what they could have won when the former Villa man lines up against them, having made a flying start for Xabi Alonso’s team Chelsea thought they had little chance of signing Morgan Rogers at the start of the summer. Xabi Alonso and the club’s recruitment team had the England international as a priority target but a deal seemed unlikely. Chelsea had endured a disappointing season, missing out on European football after finishing 10th, and their expectation was that Rogers would leave Aston Villa for Arsenal. It was towards the end of the World Cup that Chelsea were made aware of a window of opportunity. Although Arsenal could claim to be London’s top dogs after winning the Premier League they dithered in talks with Villa, raising the prospect of another club stepping in. Continue reading...

items.title: WSL transfer talking points: three things we learned from the data
items.summary: Arsenal invested the most as the leading clubs’ spending dwarfed that of the rest of the league but there was a greater emphasis on stability The Women’s Super League’s summer transfer window has closed before the start of the 2026-27 season. The finances involved are microscopic compared with the £3.4bn that Premier League clubs spent on new players but the data provides three key points of interest: which club has made the biggest improvement to their squad, who is banking on stability, and how the women’s game has outsmarted its male equivalent.
